data.summary_en: RSIgen links learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction into a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework, using DRR to select learning roles and construct training targets; on BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, it improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over three-cycle SearchGen adaptation.
